name: cc-browser-bridge
description: Connect ZCode to your existing Chrome session to read, click, type, and take screenshots in a selected background tab, with visible activity status.

description_i18n.en: Connect ZCode to your existing Chrome session to read, click, type, and take screenshots in a selected background tab, with visible activity status.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 连接 ZCode 与日常 Chrome，在指定后台标签页读取网页、点击、输入和截图，并显示操作状态。
